==Summary==

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Continuing from Embers Falling on Dry Grass, Egwene, being reduced to [[novice]], begins her campaign of civil disobedience to undermine [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida's]] authority and legitimacy from within the [[White Tower]]. Importantly, and central to this, she intends to oppose Elaida's tyranny rather than opposing the valid structure and culture of the White Tower itself. Egwene is not anti-spanking nor does she oppose the function of the [[Mistress of Novices]]. Her stance, both inward and outward, is thereby not to deny the legitimacy and value of chastisement in the White Tower, it is specifically an assertion that as the [[Amyrlin Seat]] the punishments she is being given are procedurally illegitimate. Furthermore, she aims to show that the punishments she is receiving are ultimately due to the politically motivated machinations and cruelty of Elaida, with Elaida distorting the otherwise valid purpose and outcome such punishments have regarding the individual and for the greater good. Her status as a novice (and moreover having been demoted to one), her deliberate and specific defiance, and institutional politics regarding the [[White Tower Schism|schism]] all combine to see her being treated especially stringently by many in the Tower and being spanked exceptionally frequently.

Egwene, in her status once again as a novice, is given her first spanking from the [[Mistress of Novices]], [[Silviana Brehon]]. Egwene decides to embrace and welcome the pain; she makes no effort to stifle her sobs or control the kicking of her legs as she is slippered, and once the slippering stops she feels a sense of calm in its aftermath. Silviana informs Egwene about [[Leane Sharif]] in the open cells and says that Egwene may visit her. Silviana tells Egwene she can leave and that she should be quick about it if she wants to eat before class. Egwene refuses to courtesy as she leaves as she asserts she is the legitimate [[Amyrlin Seat]], earning her another punishment later that day. As Egwene leaves she finds [[Alviarin Freidhen|Alviarin]] waiting outside of Silviana’s study, though neither exchange courtesies. Alviarin enters Silviana’s study and as Egwene walks away she hears Alviarin being spanked.

Before going to breakfast she returns to her room to freshen herself up, where it is revealed most of her personal possessions have been confiscated.

Egwene goes to breakfast. As she enters the dining hall she is immediately noticed by [[Nicola Treehill|Nicola]]. As Egwene moves towards the kitchen to retrieve her food, the novice [[Alvistere]] enters into confrontation with her; Egwene asserts she is the Amyrlin Seat to the shock of the novices. In the kitchen she encounters [[Laras]]. When she returns to dining hall the novices, who are aware Egwene had come from the Mistress of Novices, wait to see if she will eat standing; in response, Egwene, despite wanting to stand or at least ease herself down, sits down normally on the hard wooden bench. Conservations in the dining hall continue without an effort to include her, something Egwene is happy with as she does not want the novices to see her as one of them. After breakfast she encounters [[Katerine Alruddin]] and receives a small dose of [[Forkroot]] from so that she can only [[Channeling|channel]] a small amount for her lessons.

Egwene's first class is taught by the Accepted [[Idrelle Menford]], who fails in her attempt to humiliate her and the situation escalates into Egwene creating a scene. Katerine arrives and escorts Egwene to the Mistress of Novices, swatting Egwene's still sensitive bottom with [[Hardened Air|Air]] three times along the way before [[Jezrail]] intervenes on account of Katerine abusing her authority. Silviana slippers Egwene again. Egwene attends two more classes taught by Accepted and has two more visits to Silviana.

Given the very high rate of punishments, which includes those being actively sought by Egwene, Silviana takes the atypical step of having Egwene given [[Healing|Heaing]] at the beginning of each morning. The purpose of this is to pre-emptively prevent a situation where Egwene becomes too bruised that it will be unsafe to spank her. Later Silviana sets this to twice a day.

Additionally, after her first three classes taught by Accepted resulted in the Accepted being unable to manage Egwene, Egwene's teaching changes to being only sessions alone with Aes Sedai. Egwene uses this as an opportunity to sway them again Elaida.

The polarization in the Tower by [[Ajah]] is extreme with sisters glaring at each other whenever they meet if they are not in the same Ajah. Egwene ponders on the identities of the [[ten ferrets]] inserted into the Tower to undermine Eladia. On the second night she visits Leane, and visits her serval other subsequent nights. Leane has several other visitors and Leane works to influence them against Elaida to the extent Egwene considers Leane to having more effect than her.

Egwene's first class with an Aes Sedai is with [[Bennae Nalsad]], with Egwene informing her about the [[Thirteenth Depository]]. Later that day, she has a class with [[Lirene Doirellin]] who does not stop speaking of Elaida's mistakes, something which provides Egwene with information.

Across the days, Egwene efforts to influence the Aes Sedai against Elaida are not all successful. A class with [[Pritalle Nerbaijan]] includes discussion on the demotion of [[Shemerin]], something Egwene deems a partial success given [[Pritalle Nerbaijan|Pritalle]] sends her to Silviana when the class is finished. Despite the warning by [[Serancha Colvine]] that she will compile a list of infractions Egwene makes in her class and then send her with that list to Silviana, Egwene deliberately provokes Serancha. [[Adelorna Bastine]] warns Egwene that if Egwene makes trouble she will spank her with a hairbrush, with Egwene going over Adelorna's lap three times. Following Adelorna, Silviana sets Egwene's Healing twice each day.

Some of the novices begin giving Egwene more respect. [[Nicola Treehill|Nicola]] and [[Areina Nermasiv|Arenia]] had told inflated tales about Egwene to the them, resulting in half the novices being in awe of her and the others scornful. Foolishly some novices attempt to emulate Egwene in their classes, something which is quickly quelled by the Mistress of Novices; at the midday meal on Egwene's third day, nearly two dozen novices, including Nicola and [[Alvistere]], eat standing up with embarrassment following their visits to Silviana.

Egwene begins helping some of the novices with their weaves and giving advice to others, though only one at a time and since she considers herself an Aes Sedai she views it improper for her to befriend novices. The Tower also has problems with portions shifting around which is frightening to the novices, but Egwene tries to comfort them as best she can. Egwene is also given many chores to perform when she is not in lessons or being punished.

Egwene continues to learn information and continues in her attempts to sway people against Elaida.

[[Alviarin Freidhen|Alviarin]] approaches Egwene. Egwene vocally alludes to Alviarin being punished by the Mistress of Novices. She internally notes this has been another day where, following her own session in being punished, she has encountered Alviarin waiting outside of Silviana's study, and that there is speculation by the novices as to why Alviarin is frequently having to visit the Mistress of Novices. The blushing Alviarin deflects. Egwene questions Alviarin's loyalty to Elaida. Alviarin suggests helping Egwene to escape, though Egwene tells her she is content with her situation. Every two or three days Alviarin approaches Egwene with a similar suggestion, though Egwene distrusts Alviarin and tells her she is content with her situation.

[[Mattin Stepaneos]], the King of [[Illian]], demands to speak with Egwene. Despite the attempts of [[Cariandre Temalien|Cariandre]] to dissuade him from speaking to Egwene and Egwene speaking to him, Egwene informs that the [[Dragon Reborn]] did not kill the rulers of [[Cairhien]], [[Tear]], and [[Caemlyn]]. Cariandre orders Egwene to visit Silviana for shirking her duties and ignoring the orders of the Aes Sedai, but Egwene knows she successfully planted seeds of doubt in Mattin's head.

Egwene by chance runs into [[Beonin Marinye]] and initially believes she was the one to betray her. Beonin decided that since Egwene was captured she was no longer Amyrlin so her oath no longer applied. Thinking she has little time to spare unless she wishes to run the risk of being thought dallying by an Aes Sedai and thereby punished by one with either a hairbrush or slipper, Egwene works quickly to win Beonin over and convey what she expects of her. Beonin agrees to follow Egwene's instructions that will further undermine Elaida. Beonin admits she wants to bring Elaida down as much as Egwene does. Beonin is ordered to run messages to the sisters sent to infiltrate the Tower. Egwene finds the encounter to have been an unexpected victory despite it being followed by [[Ferane Neheran|Ferane]] punishing her.

Egwene has not had any headaches or dark dreams since she was captured. She visits Leane and mentions meeting Beonin. Leane suggests Beonin may have been a spy for Elaida, but now is beginning to see that Elaida is not a suitable Amyrlin.

She meets with [[Doesine Alwain|Doesine]] for healing and Egwene realizes that since she still uses the old way of healing, Beonin did not share the new weave with Elaida. When Doesine asks if Egwene will ever surrender to the punishments she responds that the Amyrlin should never surrender. When Doesine does not call her out for punishment for that comment, Egwene sees it as a victory. 

After an appointment that sees her punished with a split-tailed strap by Silviana, Egwene asks how [[Shemerin]] was able to be reduced to an Accepted from Aes Sedai since there was no precedent for it. Silviana says because there was no ban on the process, there was a loophole and Elaida took advantage of it. When dismissing her, Silviana seems impressed by Egwene and does not even remark on her lack of a curtsy.

When Egwene enters the dining area for breakfast, the Novices rise to their feet as she enters. [[Ashelin]] goes to the kitchen to get Egwene's breakfast tray which even has honey in the tea. She has a cushion on her seat too, but she moves it away before sitting. So far, she believes she is winning her war.
